Metadata.title: Shevent: plan your event in Lahore
Metadata.description: Plan weddings, birthdays and corporate events in Lahore with AI price ranges and vendors matched to your budget. Coming soon.

Home.title: Plan your event with real price ranges, not guesswork
Home.subtitle: Shevent splits your budget across venue, catering, decor, DJ & sound and lighting, shows typical prices for your area and date, and matches you with vendors that fit. Join the waitlist and we'll tell you when it opens.

Waitlist.label: Email or WhatsApp number
Waitlist.success: You're on the list. We'll let you know when Shevent opens.
Waitlist.privacy: We only use this to tell you when Shevent opens. We never share it.

Planner.title: Plan your event
Planner.intro: Tell us about the event and your total budget. We'll split it across venue, catering, decor, DJ & sound and lighting, and show typical prices for each.
Planner.budgetHint: You can write it in lakh, crore or rupees.

errors.total_budget_pkr: Enter a budget such as 25 lakh, 1 crore or 850000.
